description: Facts about the location that are not on the menu: address, contacts, coordinates, working hours with openNow computed in the venue timezone, delivery and pickup terms (fees, minimum order, zones, ETA), accepted payment methods and currency, shipping/return terms and links to the published legal documents. Use this before answering "are you open?", "do you deliver?", "how much is delivery?".

language.description: ISO 639-1; falls back to the location default
